name: io.github.proAutomator/livespace-crm-mcp
title: Livespace CRM MCP Server
description: Unofficial local MCP server for Livespace CRM with read tools and guarded writes.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port used by the local MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: LIVESPACE_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Bare Livespace workspace subdomain, without protocol or domain suffix.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Random bearer token of at least 32 bytes, also sent by the client.

environmentVariables.name: LIVESPACE_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Expose write tools. Keep false unless writes are deliberately required.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Random HMAC key of at least 32 bytes. Required when writes are enabled.
